summary: Phase 8 (agent branding + logo upload, payment receipt PDFs, agent-branded quotes, trip-due reminders) tested end-to-end. Backend: new test_agent_phase8_branding_receipts.py 22/22 pass; phase5/6/7 regression 74/74 pass. Frontend desktop 1920 + mobile 390: all requested flows work. No functional bugs found; only minor code-review items.

minor.issue: Check-then-insert with no unique index on notifications(ref_id, kind). A 6-request concurrent test produced no duplicates, but a race is still possible in theory. A partial unique index (or upsert) would make 'one alert per booking' guaranteed.

Receipt no. R{n} is the payment's position in the list sorted by paid_on. Deleting an earlier payment or adding a backdated one renumbers existing receipts, so a reprinted receipt can carry a different number than the one the customer holds. Consider storing a fixed sequence number on the payment.

integration_issues.flow: Logout then login as a different agent in the same tab
integration_issues.issue: Not verified (no second agent's credentials). Logout does not clear the React Query cache, and agent-profile has staleTime 60s. The logo URL /api/agent/profile/logo?v=<logo_updated_at> also has Cache-Control private max-age=86400. So the next agent may briefly see the previous agent's brand name, and possibly their logo. Suggest queryClient.clear() on logout.

action_items: Optional: add a unique index on notifications {ref_id, kind} for booking.payment_due, or use upsert, so the alert can never be duplicated
Optional: clear the React Query cache on logout so cached brand and profile data never carries over between accounts
Optional: store a fixed receipt sequence on each payment so receipt numbers never change
critical_code_review_comments: Logo validation is solid: the size check happens before parsing, PIL verify runs, only PNG/JPEG are allowed, and GIF/text/fake-PNG/>2MB are all rejected with 400

The PDF header shows the agent's email. For the demo agent that is agent.demo@biyahetabai.example.com, so a raw text search for 'Biyahe' matches the email. That is demo data, not a branding leak; real agents' emails won't match
The demo agent's phone is '+63 900 a55fa7', probably left over from an earlier test, and it shows on the PDFs. Worth cleaning in seed data
Remove-logo is a soft unlink. Objects stay in storage, which is acceptable because there is no delete API
